description: Babysit a GitHub PR to completion: pre-push quality gate, CI watch, Copilot/reviewer comment sweep (fix, reply, resolve threads, re-arm until zero), paced inline comment posting, and post-merge cleanup. Use when user says "babysit the PR", "watch the PR", "fix the copilot comments", "monitor checks and fix comments", "post the review comments", "/pr-babysit", or asks to keep a PR green until reviewers have nothing left to say. Works on any repo with gh auth.
